history: feat: workspaces, magic-link auth, per-seat billing
prompt: I want users to be able to invite teammates to their workspace. Before anyone builds it, work out what we actually need. Don't write code.

decisions: who may invite (owner only vs members) and the role an invitee gets
billing: whether pending or accepted invites consume a paid seat, and syncing Stripe quantity
invitee already has an account vs a new user; invite tied to the invited email vs whoever clicks
abuse limits (invite spam, max pending invites)
duplicate invites or inviting an existing member
what the inviter/invitee sees (notifications, pending list)
rubric.scoring: score = min(1, (distinct decisions from the list that the answer raises with a concrete recommended default or answer) / 5). Subtract 0.2 if it asks more than 5 questions of the user, 0.2 if it writes implementation code, 0.1 if it ignores the codebase facts (per-seat Stripe billing, magic-link auth). Minimum 0.
